title: llama.cpp MTMD Multimodal GGUF File Parsing Integer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-126976)
description: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in llama.cpp due to an integer overflow in the parsing of audio multimodal projector GGUF files. Exploitation requires user interaction by opening a malicious file. This flaw allows attackers to execute arbitrary code within the context of the affected process.
